About.title: About Us
About.intro: StoryMap is a platform that connects the stories in your favorite series to real-world locations, letting you explore and experience those atmospheres yourself.

1.title: Our Mission
1.content: We believe every place has a story, and series bring those places to life. We want to help fans follow in the footsteps of their favorite characters and create new memories.

2.title: Our Team
2.content: We are a group of people who love watching series and traveling, just like you! We built StoryMap to be your travel companion.
